Package com.epitech.depthdiablo.shop

Class Shopkeeper

java.lang.Object
com.epitech.depthdiablo.entity.Entity
com.epitech.depthdiablo.shop.Shopkeeper
All Implemented Interfaces:
Rewindable, Collidable, Interactable, Updatable
public final class Shopkeeper extends Entity implements Interactable
The shopkeeper, the only NPC (GDD 1.3, 1.4). In Arena mode he trades after each boss wave, while the arena cycle is in its ArenaCycle.Phase.SHOP phase, and the player starts the next round through him (GDD 1.2). The rest of the time he is away: not drawn, and talking to him does nothing. He is an entity, not a character, so he never fights and can never be hit. Buying, selling and the roulette come with the coins.
